entries.reason: Plan catalog data table (39 families / 275 ops) is pure data, not logic: it keeps the when/not/sk metadata and op lists human-readable in one file, so it carries the documented 600-line budget exemption. This replaces the removed runtime/catalog.ts ghost entry; the budget gate reads this registry instead of an inline allowlist.

Aggregation barrel for the catalog domain (data / tools / commands / logic). runtime/engine.ts and runtime/ internal callers need one stable import path per domain; the barrel holds no logic of its own, and the public facade registry (config/facades.json) records the four exports actually consumed through it.

The single documented src/ -> lib/runtime boundary: host-side code imports the built runtime entry points through this one file instead of scattering lib/ paths. Keeping the bridge as one re-export file is the boundary convention recorded in docs/architecture.md.

Cross-package reuse of private helpers from integrations/*_client.py predates the addon package split. The names stay private until those modules are next touched; the pytest private-import contract ties this registry entry to the real import graph so the entry cannot go stale.

本地进程/端口证据的唯一采集器：Windows（netstat/tasklist）与 Linux（/proc/net/tcp + cmdline）两套扫描、fixture 注入、证据投影与 false_positive 判定共享同一份输出上限/超时/角色映射，拆文件会把同一套判据拆成两处口径。800 行超过 600 预算，登记为例外并在 2027-06-30 前复核（拆分为 scan/ 与 project/ 两段）。

无头常驻 worker 以单文件方式启动（worker-start.ts 直接把 runtime/py/core/worker.py 交给 blender -b --python），同目录模块要额外解决传输与 sys.path 注入；1428 行超过 runtime/py 的 1000 行预算，先登记例外，拆分（accept loop / digest / checkpoint 三段）排到 2027-06-30 前复核。
view.py 由 injectModule / preload 按**单份源码字符串**注入 Blender（facade + <stem>_impl 才是多文件通道），拆文件会改变注入与失效指纹契约；1187 行超过 1000 行预算，先登记例外，矩阵/投影与 PNG/诊断两段拆分排到 2027-06-30 前复核。
本地无头车道的领域 barrel：table.ts（op 名 → routing 行/模块/preload）与 driver.ts（作业脚本 + HEADLESS 回执）是本车道唯一的两段实现，spawn-executor 与单测都从这一条路径取，避免在执行器里散落两处 import。barrel 自身无逻辑（三条纯再导出），多语句是因为类型与值分属两个模块。
